script_text: Stop scrolling! Sagittarius, this week the cosmos fires up your adventurous spirit. Monday brings Mercury trine Jupiter, perfect for expanding ideas and signing beneficial contracts—write that proposal now. Tuesday sees Venus square Mars, stirring tension in relationships; pause before committing, channel energy into creative projects. Wednesday’s Sun sextile Uranus sparks sudden insight; trust intuition and try a new workout routine. Thursday’s Moon opposite Saturn warns against overcommitment—set realistic boundaries at work. Friday’s Mars conjunct Pluto fuels deep transformation; let go of old habits and start a meditation practice. Saturday offers a gentle Neptune flow, ideal for spiritual journaling and dreaming big. Sunday’s bright Sun in Leo amplifies confidence; share your vision with friends. BEST DAY: Monday, when optimism and communication align. WORST DAY: Thursday, when pressure builds. Actionable tip: each morning, write one clear intention and revisit it at sunset and trust the stars' guidance.
title: Sagittarius Weekly Forecast 12-18 Feb
